hypothesis: Use a uniform negative-test construction predicate and a source-bound CSI input-domain guard to suppress unsupported alerts while retaining complete component outputs.

policy.selection: Copy the first non-null complete alert in the frozen component order for every original trial.
policy.scope: Validate sealed document bytes, declared complete row projections, common source bytes and exact alert identity.
policy.source_identity: Every trial shares corpus/frontend/issue SHA256; any overlapping case/selection metadata must also have equal SHA256. Verify every declared source file.
policy.code_commit: Verify that each declared full immutable commit exists. The commit is recorded provenance, not a verification of the component algorithm closure.
policy.underlying_execution: Delegate provider/native provenance and semantic validity to separately identified component evidence. Do not open those audit artifacts here.
policy.cost: This composition makes zero fresh provider calls and zero native executions. It does not infer a cold-run cost from historical summaries.

priority_origin: Frozen in round14 protocol before its formal replay; all17 use the same component order.
limitations: This thin wrapper verifies declared sealed summaries and common sources, not the original execution closures.
All component semantic conclusions inherit prior non-human review, prior exposure and contract limitations.
The fixed predicates and component family were developed on these trials. This is not held-out accuracy and does not establish general false-positive rate.
All 17 trials are development-exposed and cover 14 independent tasks.
